t: A mistake turns into a virtue when it gives rise to humility within a person.
The worst wrongdoing is boasting about one’s own righteousness.
The gravest wrongdoer is not the one who makes a mistake, but refuses to admit it.
The only true wealth you own is the present moment; and what you do with it determines who you become.
A truly creative person is one who can turn obstacles into opportunities and difficulties into discoveries.
An Islamic character is a divine character. It is to treat others with the same generosity as God shows to man.
Those who discover that life gives less than they seek discover lasting peace.
A person who always complains is rendered incapable of thinking positively. And this sort of mentality is, without a shred of doubt, the root of all ills.
When a person does good to you, try to recompense him, and if you can’t recompense him, pray to God for him.
Everyone in this world should behave as a morally responsible servant of God and everyone is given equal opportunities to do so.
O God! I seek Your refuge from that Knowledge which is not beneficial, from that supplication which goes unanswered, from that heart that does not fear You, and from the self that is never satiated

The Companions of the Prophet serve as timeless exemplars of detachment from worldly pleasures and commitment to a righteous life. Their legacy continues to inspire believers to prioritize their faith over material pursuits.
God has the most excellent names. (7: 180)
When we put our cares in God's hands, He puts His peace in our hearts.
Have you seen him who has taken his own desire to be his god?
"The tree teaches us the lesson that if we seek to progress outwardly, we must first strengthen our-selves inwardly"
Punctuality is a sign of a responsible person. A responsible person cannot afford to be forgetful of time.

The greatest success in this world is to live life in such a manner that you should not have an iota of negative thought against any person. You should depart from this world with a totally positive mindset. This is my last discovery in this world.
What inspires a man more than anything is to have a great mission before him. This arouses a man’s hidden potential and makes him capable of all manners of sacrifices.
One sign of a principled person is his strictness with himself, and his tolerance towards others.

Everything in this world could be used to develop oneself positively or can be used to bring negativity. One should make responsible choices as these choices will dictate whether one will succeed or fail in life.

Life cannot but appear meaningless to a person who has no conception of the afterlife. The significance of the present world can be understood only in the context of our present life being followed by the Hereafter.

The nature of human intellect and his urges demand that his mental prowess is guided by a divine guidance. Islamic scripture, the Quran, is the preserved revelation from the Creator to guide man about the meaning and purpose of his existence.

Death is not the end of a person’s life. It is only the beginning of the next stage of life. Death is that interim stage when man leaves this temporary world of today for the eternal world of tomorrow.
It was this magnanimity of the Prophet that gave him the power to capture people’s hearts: the closer one came to him, the more one would be won over by his noble character.
One who has fear of God will see his affairs in relation to God, the Almighty. When one sees oneself in relation to God, everyone becomes small, in relation to God.
A basic principle of success in life is that, in controversial matters, one should willingly accept whatever is available to one at the very outset.
Mary, the mother of Jesus, described in Quran as “one exalted above all womankind,” has a whole chapter of the Quran (number 19) named after her, which tells of the miraculous birth of Jesus.
Corruption has set in on land and sea because of the evil which men’s hands have done; and so He will make them taste the fruit of some of their doings, so that they may turn back from evil. (Quran)

The truth is that all the teachings of Islam are based, directly or indirectly, on the principle of peace. While all Islamic objectives may be achieved in a peaceful atmosphere, there are no Islamic objectives which may be achieved in a violent atmosphere.
It is the fault of our own thinking that we consider somebody inferior and somebody else superior. If people realize this, their lives will become filled with gratitude.
One of the Quranic teachings is tauba, which means repentance. When you make a mistake and do tauba, the blessing of God will return to you.
Education is the only guarantee for the future. No other pursuits, can be a guarantee for a better future.
Understand the conditions and demands of the new age, discover the opportunities and adapt.

Prophet Muhammad was instructed by God to follow the guidance of the Prophets before him. By extension, all the followers of Prophet Muhammad must also seek guidance from the lives of the other Prophets.
Man has been given a strong mind, along with physical weakness. This equation is a blessing. His weakness becomes a motivating force for intellectual development.
If you want to do anything meaningful in today’s times, a basic condition is deep understanding of the times. Without this you can do nothing meaningful.
There is only one option for Muslims now—and that is peaceful settlement of disputes. The option of war has ended.
Just one incident of killing can deprive people of the respect for the sanctity of human life.
The truly successful person is one who is prepared to battle through fire and water right to the very end.
Fulfilment is the deepest aspiration of the human being. But seldom does anyone attain this objective before he dies.
Inner peace is something which a spiritual person holds dearer than anything else, for he needs look no further than his own inner resources for satisfaction in life.
